mini.track_lock.goal.en: Keep the crosshair on the target for 60% of 20 seconds
mini.track_lock.goal.zh-TW: 20 秒內讓準星停在目標上，達 60%

mini.track_lock.link.en: A fleeting science opportunity is only caught if attitude control points the instrument right at the target. The steadier the pointing, the better the shot, and only a captured event earns bonus science.
mini.track_lock.link.zh-TW: 短暫的科學機會得靠姿態控制，把儀器準準對著目標才拍得到。指向越穩越容易拍到，拍到了才有額外的科學分。
